newsitem.title: UK: Portillo sees growth in UK defence private funding.
newsitem.headline: Portillo sees growth in UK defence private funding.

text.p: The British Defence Secretary Michael Portillo said on Monday that the Private Finance Initiative (PFI), which combines private sector and government funding, has become a "huge growth area" in defence.
In the text of a speech to be delivered to the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) here, he said that nine contracts worth 330 million stg had been placed in the last year.
Last week, a consortium led by British Telecommunications Plc was selected as preferred bidder for a 700 million stg military telecoms system, also under the umbrella of PFI.
"We are now examining another 50 projects worth 2.0 billion stg and are receiving offers from business for servces up to and including fighting equipment," Portillo said.

He added that among the most important projects being considered for PFI was the creation of a new joint services command and staff college to provide education and training for senior military personnel.
